From: Liam O'Connor <liam@openrepo.io>

Date: 2026-08-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Interested in Redwood for OpenRepo — short demo?

Hi Olga / Redwood team,

We just signed up and poked around the hosted API — looks promising for a GitHub app we maintain (OpenRepo). Primary questions up front: how do you handle webhook-driven spikes, do you support transparent KV cache reuse across requests, and what are the typical integration steps for an OSS project with many small repos?

Would love a 30-minute walkthrough to see the integration options and understand performance implications. Our engineering manager (cc'd QA team) is available most mornings PT next week.

Thanks,
Liam

liam@openrepo.io

Hi Liam — great to meet you and thanks for signing up. I'm Marissa on the SDR team; Olga is our solutions lead and Ben is the AE who owns your account. We'd be happy to run a focused 30-minute demo that covers: onboarding for OSS projects, webhook/burst handling, KV/prefix caching options, and a quick perf/latency profile for batch webhook workloads.

Are any of these slots good for you next week?
- Tue 2026-08-18 09:00–09:30 PT
- Wed 2026-08-19 10:00–10:30 PT
- Thu 2026-08-20 08:30–09:00 PT

If none work, feel free to pick a time on my calendar: https://calendly.com/marissa-cole/30min

Quick ask to prep: could you share a short list of the biggest current pain points (rate limits, payload size, concurrency) and a contact for your infra/QA person so we can tailor the demo. I've attached a short security questionnaire we usually share ahead of enterprise conversations — optional for OSS, but helpful.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Wed 10:00 PT would work best for us, but a heads-up: our lead infra engineer has a deploy window Wed morning and prefers 11:00–11:30 PT if that slot is available. Can you do 11:00–11:30 PT instead? If not we'll take Wed 10:00.

Pain points:
- Bursty webhook traffic when repos get big PRs; main concern is tail latency
- We prefer small, idempotent requests and reuse of cached prefixes across repos
- Open-source: we want a clear read on data residency and ephemeral retention policies

Infra contact: QA Team <qa@openrepo.io> (they handle CI / test harness and will join).

Also curious whether you recommend a short pre-demo checklist (e.g., creating API keys, adding a test webhook).

Best,
Liam

Liam — 11:00–11:30 PT Wed works for us. I've tentatively reserved that window on our side.

Pre-demo checklist (short):
1) Create a free API key from the dashboard and share the truncated key with us (we'll only need prefix for connectivity testing).
2) If you can add a single test repo and a webhook that posts a small payload (~2–3KB) that helps us show real latency numbers.
3) If you can attach a lightweight architecture snapshot (diagram) of where webhooks flow into your infra, drop it in the thread or the Drive link.

Olga — can you lead the demo and cover the caching/burst discussion? I'll run the roadmap + product fit portion.

Thanks — calendar invite to follow.

Best,
